senses.gloss: ch. (preced.) to go around, come back, return.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 3:19">Targ. Y. Gen. III, 19</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 14a:10">B. Mets. 14ᵃ</cite> what thou takest from him, <he>עלי דידי ה׳</he> comes back on my property (I am responsible for it).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 69b:4">Ib. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>הַדְרָא בעינא</he> is returned bodily.
<cite ref="Pesachim 29b:4">Pes. 29ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ה׳ ביה</he> went back on himself, changed his opinion.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 65a:2">B. Mets. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>הַדְרִי בי</he> I take it back.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 84a:1">B. Bath. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>לא מצית הַדְרַת בך וכ׳</he> thou wouldst not have been at liberty to retract (the transaction), and now thou shouldst &c.?; a. fr. [Frequ. used adverbially.] <cite ref="Bava Metzia 6a:12">B. Mets. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>שתיק מעיקרא וה׳ צוח</he> first he kept silence and then (reconsidering) he protested.
<cite ref="Gittin 8b:7">Gitt. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ אמר אביי</he> another time A. said.
<cite ref="Chullin 76b:16">Ḥull. 76ᵇ</cite> (<he>הדר</he>) <he>הֲדוּר שלחו</he> another time they sent word; a. fr.
<cite ref="Daniel 4:31">Dan. IV, 31</cite>.—
Targ. O. Lev. XIX, 15 (ed. Berl. תַהְדּר Af.).—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 3b:13">B. Bath. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>הַדְּרֵי</he>, v. <cite ref="E00211"><he>הוּדְרָא</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to go around searching, be zealous, anxious.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 76b:16">Ḥull. 76ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 65b:37">Nidd. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>הַדּוּרֵי אפירכא</he> what need is there to go around searching for an argument (why do you resort to unknown authorities)? <cite ref="Shabbat 23a:4">Sabb. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה מְהַדֵּר מר וכ׳</he> my teacher used to be anxious for puppy-oil.
<cite ref="Shabbat 23a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>מהדרא אמשחא</he> (read: <he>מהדר אמ׳</he>); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to return, restore; to lead back; to turn around.
units: Targ. Y. Deut. XXXII, 3 (some ed. Pa.).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 7:5">Targ. Cant. VII, 5</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 26a:4-13">B. Mets. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>אי … לאַהֲדוּרָהּ אַהַדְרוּהָ ניהלי</he> if they had had the intention of returning it, they would have returned it to me.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 26a:13">Ib.</cite> <he>אמרי קמייהו … לִיהַדְּרוּ לי ולא הַדְּרוּ לי וכ׳</he> (differ. in Mss., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) I spoke in their presence several times (of my loss); they might have returned it to me, but did not; will they now return it?—
<cite ref="Chullin 20a:1">Ḥull. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>בדלא א׳</he> when he did not turn round (the windpipe &c.).
<cite ref="Chagigah 5b:3">Ḥag. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>עמא דַאֲהַדְרִינְהוּ … מיניה</he> a people from which its master has turned away his face; a. fr.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 28a:22">M. Kat. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>אֲהַדְרִי לתלמודאי</he> that I may review my studies.
<cite ref="Berakhot 38b:10">Ber. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>מַהֲדַר תלמודיה</he> (or <he>מְהַדֵּר</he>); a. fr.
<cite ref="Chullin 34a:5">Ḥull. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>מאי אהדרי וכ׳</he> what did … reply to one another?; a. e.
<cite ref="Yevamot 110a">Yeb. 110ᵃ</cite> Ar., v. <cite ref="K00393"><he>כּוּרְסַיָּא</he></cite>; v. <cite ref="A00391"><he>אֲדוּרֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 151b:13">Sabb. 151ᵇ</cite> <he>אַהֲדוּרֵי אפיתחא לא מִיהֲדַר</he> he will not be forced to go around begging.
<cite ref="Nedarim 50a:4">Ned. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>איהדר לאחורי</he> I will go back again.
